name: How to Optimize a PDF for an E-Reader
description: Crop margins and optimize contrast for Kindle, Kobo & reMarkable — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Pick your device and adjust contrast
step.text: Choose Kindle, reMarkable / Boox, or Kobo / Nook, then adjust the contrast slider. The live before/after preview updates as you go.

step.name: Download your optimized PDF
step.text: Click 'Optimize for E-Reader'. Every page is processed and ready to download instantly.
